# Front Porch Sports

> A free college football reference site built on a complete head-to-head game
> database: every result between major programs from 1887 to the present, plus
> all-time program rankings and per-team history.

Front Porch Sports answers one kind of question well: what has actually happened
between two college football programs, and how does any program rank all-time.
It is a reference tool, not a news site. There is no editorial content, no
opinion, and no paywall.

## Dataset

- 54,000+ completed games through the 2025 season (the count grows each season).
- Coverage: 1887 through the present.
- 136 current FBS programs have full profile pages; historical and FCS opponents
  appear in head-to-head records where they played an FBS program.
- Refreshed weekly during the season (August-January) from live results.
- The raw data is public: https://frontporchsports.com/front_porch_games.json

## Site structure

- https://frontporchsports.com/ - Home. Rivalry lookup and featured matchups.
- https://frontporchsports.com/teams - Directory of all 136 FBS programs.
- https://frontporchsports.com/schedules - Full season schedules for every FBS
  team, 2022-2026, including FCS and other non-FBS opponents that the head-to-head
  dataset does not cover. /schedules?team=NAME&year=YYYY for one team-season.
  Example: /schedules?team=Oklahoma%20St.&year=2026
- https://frontporchsports.com/scoreboard - Live college football scoreboard for
  the current season: in-progress scores with quarter and clock, final results and
  upcoming kickoff times, filterable by week and conference.
- https://frontporchsports.com/team?team=NAME - One program: all-time record,
  head-to-head record against every opponent it has played, season-by-season
  results, conference and national ranking context.
  Example: /team?team=Alabama
- https://frontporchsports.com/compare?team1=A&team2=B - Two programs head to
  head: series record, current streak, scoring history, era filters.
  Example: /compare?team1=Oklahoma&team2=Texas
- https://frontporchsports.com/games?team1=A&team2=B - Every individual game in
  a series, with date, score and result.
- https://frontporchsports.com/rankings - All-time program rankings across 12
  categories.
- https://frontporchsports.com/rank?cat=SLUG - One ranking category in full.
  Slugs include: all-time-record, all-time-wins, claimed-national-championships,
  recognized-national-championships, conference-championships, bowl-games,
  all-americans, heisman-winners, nfl-draft-picks, first-round-nfl-draft-picks,
  weeks-in-poll, weeks-at-ap-number-one
- https://frontporchsports.com/heisman - Heisman Trophy winners by program.

## Notes for automated readers

- Team names in URLs use the site's canonical short form, which abbreviates
  "State" as "St." - for example /team?team=Oklahoma%20St. and
  /team?team=Appalachian%20St. The full list is at
  https://frontporchsports.com/fbs_teams.json
- Page content is rendered client-side from JSON. A fetch that does not execute
  JavaScript will receive a page shell rather than the data. Read the JSON
  endpoints directly instead: front_porch_games.json (all games),
  fbs_teams.json (team list and metadata), program_stats.json (per-program
  totals), historical_opponents.json.
- An unrecognised ?team= value falls back to a default program rather than
  returning an error.
